newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan sets ceiling for mainland investment at US$50 million per company.
Vice President and Premier Lien Chan says sincerely wishes for Beijing to resume dialogue with Taiwan.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Premier Lien asks Japanese government to show restraint in row over disputed East China Sea archipelago.
LIBERTY TIMES - Premier Lien says he will decide whether to run for president based on "future conditions".
Japanese pop star Namie Amuro rocks Taipei.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to form foreign exchange market development committee at end of May.
Taiwan's trade surplus is largest against Hong Kong.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Premier Lien says cross-strait negotiations can involve political issues.
Central bank is happy to see depreciation of Taiwan dollar.
